clips.title: The story
paras: At Ironband's Compound, Tormus Deepforge seeks vengeance for his slain mentor. Sturgy Ironband's teaching outpost in eastern Dun Morogh fell after a shipment of rare umbral ore drew the Dark Iron dwarves.

Sturgy Ironband taught smithing at a secluded compound south of Helm's Bed Lake. Across Ironforge, he was revered as an unmatched instructor. He trained promising pupils far from the crowded anvils of the Great Forge. That peaceful work ended when one student acquired an unfamiliar mineral called umbral ore. Intrigued by its properties, Ironband chose to experiment with the sample. He did not know that possessing the ore had marked his school for ruin.

Dark Iron dwarves attacked the compound soon after the umbral ore arrived. The assault was sudden and ruthless. They killed Sturgy Ironband and every apprentice in his care, then took over the grounds. Tormus Deepforge, one of Ironband's surviving protégés in the capital, refuses to let the massacre go unanswered. He sends Alliance travelers to avenge his teacher and recover the ore that brought destruction to the outpost.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: My mentor, Sturgy Ironband, had a compound south of Helm's Bed Lake in eastern Dun Morogh. There he taught blacksmithing and he was the best.

But one day, one of his students brought him a load of strange ore. Master Ironband called it umbral ore and was eager to work with it, but soon after it arrived... A band of Dark Iron dwarves attacked his compound. They killed everyone!
Enter Ironband's compound, friend, and avenge my master's death. And bring me the load of umbral ore that caused it.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you entered Ironband's Compound? Did you find the umbral ore?

clips.title: Completion
paras: I hope you killed a host of Dark Iron dwarves while searching. I fear that Ironband's compound won't be the last place we see them.
But thank you for the ore, friend. I'm eager to work it and find its properties.
